title: Uniform finiteness and canonical reductions of the adic purity source
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$ is prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring, $\varpi_E$ is a uniformizer, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ and $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$, for $W=X,Y$. Write $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_Y}B_{n,Y}$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $f_n$ denote $f$ with coefficients $B_{n,Y},B_{n,X}$. Use integral pullback and completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] and the twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Put $U=Lf^*K(d)[2d]$ and $U_n=Lf_n^*K_n(d)[2d]$.

The source $U$ belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$. More precisely, if $[r,s]$ contains the cohomological support of every $K_n$ and $[a,b]$ is a Tor-amplitude interval of every $K_n$, then every $U_n$ is constructible with cohomological support in $[r-2d,s-2d]$ and Tor amplitude in $[a-2d,b-2d]$, with both intervals independent of $n$. The canonical source reduction map $b^U_n:U\otimes^L_{R_X}B_{n,X}\to U_n$ of [def-pur-adic-source-reduction] is an isomorphism in $D(B_{n,X})$ for every $n\geq1$; these maps intertwine successive and direct quotient normalization maps, including their identity and composition cocycles [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum].

proof.text: Shift by 2d. The homology shift comparison gives support [r-2d,s-2d], and the quantitative finite-ctf triangulated theorem gives Tor interval [a-2d,b-2d]. Integral constructibility is shift stable. Transport the reduction Tor interval through the canonical reduction-shift isomorphism; this proves integral ctf for the actual source.

proof.text: The pulled reduction system counit is invertible by the published completed-pullback tensor comparison. Twist by d is an equivalence, with inverse twist by -d, at both finite and integral coefficients. The prescribed twist reduction, composed with its presentation isomorphism, is the inverse mate of the twist/restriction isomorphism, by its unit equation. The inverse-mate equivalence theorem makes it invertible. Every factor in the actual source reduction is now invertible.

proof.text: Apply the source-transition square. Transpose under the finite scalar adjunction and use naturality of the prescribed restriction identification; by the definitions of both normalizations this is exactly the displayed direct-quotient square.

proof.text: The actual integral reduction transitions satisfy the unit and composition laws by the general reduction cocycle lemma. Transfer each equality through the invertible source reductions using the source-transition square. Naturality of restriction unit and compositor, functoriality, and cancellation of the largest-index source reduction give precisely the two finite-source cocycles.
